text:
Framework 5.0 is out. It's our fastest, cleanest release yet.

We've dropped support for Node 16, which lets us take advantage of a modern runtime. The new router is 2.3x faster than the old one, so your apps should feel snappier and your users will notice.

Upgrading can feel like a big step, so we've tried to make it easier. This release has 7 breaking changes, but we've included a codemod that does most of the work. Run it, review the changes, and you're done.

Whether you're starting a new product or updating an existing project, 5.0 is worth the move. Upgrade today.
